g.text: NAT: sharing one public IP, and why unsolicited packets die
The router rewrites the source on the way out and remembers the mapping to undo it on the way back.
1 PC sends 2 router swaps in its public IP + a fresh port, records the pair 3 reply arrives at that port 4 router swaps the PC back in.
A packet for a port with NO entry (red) has no owner inside, so it is dropped.
